data.name: Pinnacles Park Store
data.description: Get your passport stamped and buy the official park souvenirs, all at the park store! Located in the Pinnacles campground, the store is open everyday, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, including holidays. This fully stocked park store is operated by a private, non-profit organization called Western National Parks Association (WNPA). The park store carries a large variety of books, games, and souvenirs to help you learn more about the park and its resources.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: This location has the general Pinnacles passport stamp. Forgot your book? No problem, we will provide a piece of paper to stamp.

passportStampImages.altText: Pinnacles National Park, Paicines, CA, January, 30, 2021

data.directionsInfo: Pinnacles Park Store is located off of Highway 25, thirty miles south of Hollister, California. Head two miles down the park road (East Entrance Road) and you will find the store on your left hand side, in the campground.

data.name: West Pinnacles Visitor Contact Station
data.description: Get your park souvenirs and plan your visit all in one place! Please note that this visitor center may be closed seasonally due to available staffing.

passportStampImages.altText: Pinnacles National Park, Paicines, CA, January, 30, 2021
passportStampImages.title: Pinnacles stamp with location

data.directionsInfo: The west entrance does not have a physical address. It is located just outside the town of Soledad; follow Hwy 146 for 14 miles into Pinnacles National Park. The contact station is on your right hand side when you enter the park.

operatingHours.description: The West Pinnacles contact station is open daily depending on available staffing. Please note that this contact station may close seasonally when we are low staffed.

data.name: Bear Gulch Nature Center
data.description: Hey ranger, what plant is this? Hey ranger, what do condors look like? Ask questions, get information and view our park film inside the Bear Gulch Nature Center. Please note that this visitor center may be closed seasonally due to available staffing.

passportStampImages.altText: Pinnacles National Park, Paicines, CA, January, 30, 2021
passportStampImages.title: Pinnacles stamp with location

data.directionsInfo: Located on the east side of the park at the Bear Gulch Day Use Area.

operatingHours.description: The Bear Gulch Nature Center is a small, humble, interpretive center. Park Rangers are usually in the area, ready to answer visitor questions! Please note that this visitor center may be closed seasonally depending on available staffing.
